title: Benign — dental appointment reminder
summary: Ben's dental practice rings to confirm a check-up. An ordinary call: it must never be offered for takeover and gets no report.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Hi, is that Ben? It's Chloe calling from Harbour Street Dental.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: I'm just ringing to remind you about your check-up with Doctor Shah on Tuesday at ten past nine.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Oh yes, thanks for the reminder.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Can you still make that time, or would you like to move it?

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Tuesday at ten past nine is fine.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Lovely. If you've started any new medication since your last visit, could you bring a list along?

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: Great. If anything changes, just give reception a ring on the number on your appointment card.

screening.speaker: customer
screening.text: Perfect, thanks Chloe. See you Tuesday.

screening.speaker: caller
screening.text: See you then, have a good afternoon. Bye now.
